Resource Profile: Paciente SIHCE (PatientXBA)

Official URL: http://sihce.gob.ar/StructureDefinition/PatientXBA Version: 1.2.0
Draft as of 2025-02-28 Computable Name: PacienteSIHCE

Perfil de Patient para interoperabilidad SIHCE vía X-BA (empadronamiento y federación)

Usages:

  • Use this Profile: Parametros Patch Identifier SIHCE and Parametros Update SDM SIHCE
  • Examples for this Profile: Patient/PersonaSIHCEMin and Patient/PersonaSIHCEPatch

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
